During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], an '''ambassador''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaadja/Legends|Zaadja]] attempted to sign an agreement with one of the galactic powers, leading operatives of the other government to try and sabotage the accord.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Not So Fast}}</ref>
